title: Data upgrade failed
desc: A local data upgrade did not finish, so the app is unavailable. Try again first; reset only if it keeps failing.
retryFailed: Failed to send the restart command, please restart the app manually
resetConfirmDesc: This deletes all settings and the local database: API keys, engine selections, learning data (vocabulary and favourites), and subtitle translation caches. Video files and downloaded model resources are not affected. This cannot be undone.
